summary: SOCRadar Attack Surface Management Business: discovery and inventory of all the company’s external assets with extended features.
value: It shows everything the company exposes to the internet.
Forgotten assets and new risks are spotted in time.
The attack surface map updates itself.
simple: Continuously searches the internet for everything the company owns: domains, websites, IP addresses, services, cloud storage, code repositories — and keeps an inventory of these assets with an attack surface map. Finds misconfigurations in email, DNS, SSL certificates, websites and cloud, information leaks and open ports; passively checks for vulnerabilities and prioritizes risks. Weekly scans, plus analysis and scoring of the company’s mobile applications; audit log and SSO.
notIncluded: API, integrations and the OnWatch service are in Ultimate.
